name: price-full-price-list
description: Builds a Full-Price Work List per service, with what clients pay for beyond the output, the evidence from your own work for each item, and what no longer earns full price and why. Use for "run price-full-price-list", "what do I still charge full price for", "AI did most of the work, what am I paid for", "what is my work worth beyond the deliverable", "what should I stop charging for", "justify my fee now that AI exists", "what can clients do themselves now", part of the Pricing Under AI Pressure Pack by 90n.
